2026-11-02.title: Hurricanes’ Välimäki & Kotkaniemi Are Making the Most of Their Opportunities
2026-11-02.summary: With the Global Series right around the corner, Carolina Hurricanes' Juuso Välimäki & Jesperi Kotkaniemi have made a case to play those games.
